ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var bookId = baseUrl.match(/(\d+)/)[1];
result = java.ajax("https://wxapp.qidian.com/api/book/categoryV2?bookId=" + bookId + "&_csrfToken=");
var charts = [];
JSON.parse(result).data.vs.map(function(vol){
  vol.cs.map(function(o){
    var chart = {
      "id": o.id,
      "title": o.cN,
      "v": o.sS == 0,
      "t": o.uT + "  " + o.cnt + "字",
      "u": "https://m.qidian.com/chapter/" + bookId + "/" + o.id + "/"
    };
    charts.push(chart);
  });
});
charts;
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
var body = "";
if (chapter.isVip()) {
  var vipMain = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result)).select("main");
  body = vipMain.size() > 0 ? vipMain.get(0).html() : "本章为VIP章节，未登录起点账号只能看试读。请导入书架源登录后阅读。";
} else {
  var els = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result)).select("main[class*=content] p");
  var sb = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < els.size(); i++) {
    sb.push(els.get(i).html());
  }
  body = sb.join("\n");
}
body
</js>
